intake.subject: Your GP is waiting: complete your placement application
intake.bodyHtml:
Dear Pat,

I hope you're well. At GP Link, we understand that when your centre needs a skilled doctor, every moment counts.

We are currently leveraging the government's expedited Specialist pathway to place qualified doctors from the UK, Ireland, and New Zealand into Australian practices faster than ever before. To maintain this speed and secure your place in our current recruitment cycle, we have streamlined our onboarding process.

How to secure your GP placement:

Complete the Placement Application: Kindly complete our formal Placement Application Form. This allows us to build your clinic's profile, list the vacancy on our website, and begin active sourcing.

Complete our agreement: Once you complete the placement application form we will send you the agreement between GP Link and your party. Once this is completed we can officially secure you a new GP.

14-Day Sourcing Window: Once the application is live, our team moves into an intensive sourcing phase. We aim to identify and present your first qualified candidates within 14 days.

1/3 RULE: Our precision matching ensures a high success rate: we run the interview process with you, and historically, at least 1 in every 3 interviews results in a confirmed General Practitioner placement.

We currently have a limited number of qualified General Practitioners available for placement per region. To ensure your medical centre is prioritised for our upcoming intake, please return the signed agreement at your earliest convenience.
intake.signatureHtml:
Warm Regards

Khaleed Mahmoud Ibañez

CEO

GP LINK RECRUITMENT AUSTRALIA PTY LTD

mygplink.com.au

emails.subject: Application received — here's what happens next
emails.html:
GP Link

Application received

Thanks for applying for the Ballarat, VIC role — it's with your Registration Support Officer now.

What happens next
1. Your Registration Support Officer checks every interview request before the practice sees it, then puts you forward.
2. Once the practice confirms their availability, we'll email you interview times to choose from — you book the one that suits you.
3. You meet the practice. Your Registration Support Officer preps you beforehand and is on the call with you.

There is nothing you need to do right now — just keep an eye on your email.

Track your application

GP Link

Application received

Thanks for applying for the Ballarat, VIC role — it's with your Registration Support Officer now.

What happens next
1. Your Registration Support Officer checks every interview request before the practice sees it, then puts you forward.
2. Once the practice confirms their availability, we'll email you interview times to choose from — you book the one that suits you.
3. You meet the practice. Your Registration Support Officer preps you beforehand and is on the call with you.

There is nothing you need to do right now — just keep an eye on your email.

Book my free 30-minute call →
Takes 30 seconds to book · Free · No obligation

✓  Your registration route — AHPRA, AMC and where you actually sit today.

✓  What GPs with your background are genuinely earning here.

Talk soon,
The GP Link Team

You're being fast-tracked to Test Metro Practice (FAKE)

Thanks for confirming your interest — your Registration Support Officer is putting you forward to Test Metro Practice (FAKE) now.

3. You meet the practice. Your Registration Support Officer preps you beforehand and is on the call with you.

There is nothing you need to do right now — just keep an eye on your email.

Track your interview

templates.name: Chase practice for SPPA return
templates.subject: Following up, supervised practice plan (SPPA-00) for {{gpName}}
templates.body:
Dear {{practiceName}} team,

Just following up on the supervised practice plan (SPPA-00) for {{gpName}}. AHPRA cannot progress the registration until the completed and signed form is returned.

Could you please complete the practice sections and reply to this email with the signed copy attached? If anything on the form is unclear, we are happy to walk it through with you.

Kind regards,
{{rsoName}}
GP Link Registration Team

templates.name: AHPRA follow-up
templates.subject: Follow-up, registration application for {{gpName}}
templates.body:
Dear Officer,

We are writing to follow up on the registration application for {{gpName}}. Could you please advise the current status of the application, and whether anything further is required from the practitioner, the practice, or from us?

Thank you for your time.

Kind regards,
{{rsoName}}
GP Link Registration Team

templates.name: Interview confirmation
templates.subject: Interview confirmed, {{practiceName}}
templates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Great news, your interview with {{practiceName}} is confirmed. You will receive a calendar invitation with the meeting link shortly.

A few quick tips:
- Join a couple of minutes early and check your camera and microphone.
- Have a copy of your CV handy.
- Prepare one or two questions about the role and the practice.

If you need to reschedule, reply to this email as soon as you can and we will arrange a new time.

Kind regards,
{{rsoName}}
GP Link Registration Team

templates.name: Welcome / next steps
templates.subject: Welcome to GP Link, your next steps
templates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Welcome to GP Link! We are delighted to be supporting your move to general practice in Australia.

Your next steps:
1. Sign in to your GP Link portal and complete your profile.
2. Upload your qualification documents so we can verify them.
3. We will guide you through each registration stage from there, you will always be able to see what is in progress and what we need from you.

I am your Registration Support Officer, so reply to this email any time you have a question.

Kind regards,
{{rsoName}}
GP Link Registration Team
